parsed.name: Mercury步进电机多轴运动控制器
parsed.name_en: Mercury Stepper Motor Multi-Axis Motion Controller
parsed.description: 这是一种用于驱动和控制多轴步进电机定位平台的精密运动控制器，常与电动样品台、显微镜位移台或其他线性/旋转轴配合使用。它支持位置移动、位置与运动状态读取、速度设置、软件限位以及摇杆手动控制，常用于显微成像、精密定位和自动化实验平台。
parsed.description_en: This is a precision multi-axis motion controller for driving and controlling stepper-motor positioning stages. It is commonly used with motorized sample stages, microscope translation stages, or other linear/rotary axes. It supports position moves, position and motion-status readback, velocity setting, software travel limits, and joystick manual control, making it useful in microscopy, precision positioning, and laboratory automation setups.
